description: This file implements a local cache layer for file information in the Mattermost server, including cache invalidation, retrieval, and storage usage functions.

classes.name: LocalCacheFileInfoStore
classes.description: A cache layer for file info storage, providing cache management and retrieval functions.

methods.name: handleClusterInvalidateFileInfo
methods.description: Handles cache invalidation messages for file info, purging or removing cache entries.

methods.name: GetForPost
methods.description: Retrieves file info for a post, using cache if allowed.

methods.name: GetByIds
methods.description: Retrieves file info by IDs, utilizing cache when possible.

methods.name: ClearCaches
methods.description: Clears the file info cache and updates metrics.

methods.name: InvalidateFileInfosForPostCache
methods.description: Invalidates cache entries related to a specific post.

methods.name: GetStorageUsage
methods.description: Returns storage usage, using cache if permitted.
